title: A film is a web page on a timeline

items.caption: HTML and CSS with paused animations, seeked frame by frame.
The homepage framed so the headline stays in view, in every format.
WCAG AA solved per color, checked on 500 random palettes.
180 quality checks across 16 evals, on every change.
Durable steps on Postgres: a killed worker resumes where it stopped.
React 19, Fastify 5, Zod 4, Puppeteer and ffmpeg.

end: Open source and free to run.
